summary.text: Michael Stoddard, a Libertarian Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Utah's 3rd Congressional District to Celeste Maloy.
He was chosen at the party's convention on April 18, 2026, in his second run for the seat after appearing on the 2022 ballot as the Libertarian candidate.

paragraphs.text: Stoddard first ran for the 3rd District in 2022, when he was one of five candidates on the general election ballot.
He received 2.9% of the vote (8,287 votes), finishing third behind Rep. John Curtis, who won with 64.4%, and Democrat Glenn J. Wright.
He received 2.2% of the vote to Celeste Maloy's 57.1%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
